shared_elements: rows/columns of incised script-like signs occupying the upper zone
large single figure occupying most of the field, rendered in low relief
justification: The only notable correspondence is structural rather than iconographic: both present a single large relief-carved subject with a band/zone of incised script-like signs in the upper part, plus generic disc motifs. A shows a clearly legible composite scene \u2014 a bird-headed winged figure in profile striding toward a stylised palmette tree with cone and bucket \u2014 whereas B shows a bulky frontal mass with only vague roundels and curved ridges, no wings, no tree, no profile figure, and no comparable pairing of elements.
